args.title: Juniper freight blog + companion: three-bullet summary
args.body:
- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady (source: blog.juniper.example/2026/freight).
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices, making them more volatile and closely tied to fuel markets.
- Per the companion piece (insights.juniper.example/freight/companion), shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
